scientific_integrity: Each configuration is considered exactly once as a marked point with an unordered triangle. Distances use the closed convex triangle. Exhaustive exact-rational enumeration and an independent candidate-minimum calculation are supplied; no probabilistic sampling or outside certification is claimed.
scientific_limitations: An exact finite classification for marked full-dimensional lattice tetrahedra in the three-level cube. No claim for larger grid cubes, general lattice polytopes, coplanar point–triangle configurations, or an asymptotic theorem. The already published minimum and unique minimizing orbit are acknowledged; possible unindexed prior complete censuses remain a novelty risk.
title: Exact vertex-to-opposite-triangle distance spectrum in the \(3\times3\times3\) lattice cube
